name: Bluefen
summary: Bluefen’s marsh paths put travelers between swamp predators and Theramore scouts. The bog lies in northern Dustwallow Marsh, just east of Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: A Contested Bog
sections.body: East of Brackenwall Village, home to the Stonemaul ogres, Bluefen’s wet ground teems with danger. Raptors, giant spiders, carrion-feeding birds, and crocolisks prowl the marsh. Theramore Infiltrators also move through the bog, watching Horde movements and carrying human influence deeper into the swamp.

faq.answer: Bluefen lies in northern Dustwallow Marsh, just east of Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: What threats can be found in Bluefen?
faq.answer: Raptors, giant spiders, crocolisks, and carrion-feeding birds hunt in Bluefen. Theramore Infiltrators also scout the marsh and threaten Horde travelers.

faq.q: Why are Theramore scouts active in Bluefen?
faq.answer: Theramore Infiltrators watch Brackenwall Village, home to the Stonemaul ogres, and patrol the contested paths through northern Dustwallow Marsh.

angles.text: East of Brackenwall Village, Bluefen puts Horde champions among swamp beasts and Theramore Infiltrators watching the Stonemaul ogres.
Wild beasts make travel treacherous, while Theramore scouts watch the nearby ogre encampment through Bluefen’s dense marsh foliage.
